title: PPG-MS27 — Demo Pack + ROI Proof + Pricing + ICP
description: Closes the GTM gap surfaced by R14 scrutiny (score 58). Builds the 3-screen close-the-deal demo, 5-part operator-signed witness report, public ROI calculator, ICP definition, pricing model with ASC 606 performance obligations, ≥2 design-partner LOIs, license-displacement strategy.
rationale: Closes the GTM gap surfaced by R14 scrutiny (score 58). Builds the 3-screen close-the-deal demo, 5-part operator-signed witness report, public ROI calculator, ICP definition, pricing model with ASC 606 performance obligations, ≥2 design-partner LOIs, license-displacement strategy.

units.title: 3-screen close-the-deal demo flow
units.scope: Demo: (1) Drop STEP → instant quote with cycle time; (2) Cut on real machine, telemetry overlays prediction in real-time; (3) Variance dashboard recalibrates next quote. Canned data + reset button. Sales engineer artifact.

units.title: 5-part operator-signed witness report (lighthouse proof pack)
units.scope: 5 JM Die parts: before/after PDFs + operator video + signed witness + measured ROI table. Public-shareable. Spec includes shop foreman + programmer + operator signatures.

units.title: Public ROI calculator + landing page
units.scope: Public web tool: shop inputs (machines, materials, customers, current cycle time, hourly rate) → projected savings + payback period. Bound to MS16 measured outcomes for credibility. Direct binding (S10 closure): files_to_modify wires the public ROI calculator to existing prism_business actions savings_dashboard + roi_advisor_analyze + tool_roi_analyze (already wired in business dispatcher); calculator inputs route through these engines for credibility, not duplicated math.

units.title: ICP definition + customer #2/3/4 plan
units.scope: Ideal Customer Profile: shop size (5-30 machines), CAM stack (Fusion-primary, hyperMILL/Mastercam-secondary), top 3 pains, decision process. Named customer #2/3/4 candidates with discovery-call status.

units.title: Pricing model + ASC 606 performance obligations
units.scope: Per-shop SaaS ($2k/mo base + $200/machine/mo + 2% measured savings). ASC 606: identify performance obligations (sidecar emit / AGI gates / cutover), recognition timing, deferred revenue treatment. Auditor-ready.

units.title: License-displacement strategy + ≥2 design-partner LOIs
units.scope: SolidCAM iMachining ($8-15k/seat), Vericut ($5-12k), NCSIMUL: bundle / pass-through / displacement strategy per license. ≥2 design-partner LOIs signed before MS12 cutover.

completion_criteria: 3-screen demo flow shippable to prospect in 90 seconds; sales engineer signoff
Lighthouse proof pack with 5 operator-signed witness reports public-shareable
ROI calculator live, calibrated to MS16 measured outcomes
ICP defined; ≥3 customer #2/3/4 candidates in active discovery
Pricing model + ASC 606 performance obligations documented; auditor pre-review complete
≥2 design-partner LOIs signed before MS12 cutover
